g.text: first-person view - HUD elements overlay this canvas
Name, health bar, class tag, leader star, and
a green speaking dot that flashes on voice.
Leader-issued objective; also pinned as a 3D
world marker on flag B. Bonus score on follow.
Player wedge shows heading; north locked up.
V keys squad channel (WebRTC mesh); B keys the
leader-only command net. Active chip lights.
Meter runs -100 to +100: neutralize, then capture.
Rate scales with headcount; contested = frozen.
Roster collapses to health strip; PTT becomes
